title: More ways to choose a text model
summary:
This week sharpened the text model lineup, gave eligible requests more queue room, and brought more community-built tools into the directory.

The `llama` name now points to Llama 4 Scout 17B instead of Llama 3.3 70B. `openai-reasoning` added O3 with image input, while `searchgpt` added GPT-4o mini search preview and received a routing correction. GPT-4.1 and Qwen 2.5 Coder aliases were added, `openai-fast` moved to a GPT-4.1-nano alias, and `openai-roblox` was removed.

Text model definitions gained tier and community metadata to help clients choose a model. The queue cap for token-authenticated, non-seed tiers rose from 3 to 20; Seed remains at 3, and Nectar bypasses the queue only for token-authenticated requests.

Five community projects were added across Hack & Build and Creative Projects: DynaSpark API, a Deno Deploy JSON wrapper, StoryBolt’s illustrated stories, Time Travel Selfie Portal, and Coloring AI. They put the same building blocks to work in rather different directions.
